title: carex goodenowii var. hebridensis
intro: Carex goodenowii var. hebridensis, commonly known as Carex hebridensis, is a type of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a plant traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health and alleviate coughs. The therapeutic actions of Carex hebridensis are attributed to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease congestion and reduce inflammation in the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
